evidence.observation: Reboiler dipped to ~321 °C around k=7 then recovered smoothly to ~435 °C, consistent with a transient heating excursion now settled
Column profile back to steady ~70 °C top-section and 63 °C head temperatures
Differential pressure back to ~3.0 mbar and system pressure steady near 500 mbar after brief excursion at k=4-6
Reflux and distillate flows resumed after briefly reading 0 during the excursion; ratio FYI702 steady ~6.4-7.3

args.missing_evidence: A distillate/bottoms composition measurement (GC or equivalent) to judge separation; also confirmation of whether the k=4-7 reboiler/flow dip was a real process transient or a logged control action.
